allowed_future_inputs: existing gradient geometry cache cells10 and physical volumes only
existing graph manifest interface counts/provenance metadata only
scope.minimal_read_policy: Reuse the checked prepared/cell-geometry identities; do not reopen duplicate H5, redo SolverDeck GRID mapping, scan Local13 or load any cached reference field. No43-token input architecture is selected at this stage.
scope.reads_performed_for_this_design: Small completed JSON excerpts, existing construction code and primary source pages only; no array/label/weight reads.

evidence_and_question.bounded_readout: On the fixed sampled TRAIN101_479 cells, both Hash-path H and condition-path C tensor RMS decrease with coarse8 for ver/hor/tor. The signed H-C energy cross term is negative in both models and all three loads; individual positive energies cannot be interpreted without this cancellation.
evidence_and_question.inference: C is not established as the unique failure cause. A topology context is a target-independent representation hypothesis; the hybrid H/C diagnostic is not a causal attribution or full-CAD accuracy measurement.
evidence_and_question.current_question: Can a role-preserving connected hierarchy with sparse, nonnegative, constant-preserving prolongation be prepared within a measured bounded cost, without geometry shortcuts or hard assignment jumps in the final nodal context?

fine_geometry_contract.node_order: All original volume nodes, including TETRA10 midsides, in exactly the aligned canonical prepared/H5 vertex order; do not use GRID_ID-1.
fine_geometry_contract.mapping: Existing prepared GRID-coordinate -> H5-vertex alignment remains the provenance. Match canonical prepared xyz node order/hash to the existing cells10 geometry cache without redoing raw mapping. Cache CAD/node_count/xyz_sha256/geometry/source identities.
fine_geometry_contract.xyz_normalization: x=(x_mm-bbox_min_mm)/characteristic_length_mm, with the existing isotropic max-bbox-extent L; retain physical mm coordinates or reproducible normalization metadata.
fine_geometry_contract.cells: Original cells[T,10] from the existing checked gradient geometry cache, retaining its VTK ordering/midpoint-order provenance; no remeshing or corner-only node deletion and no new raw-H5 rescan.
fine_geometry_contract.edges: For each of six corner pairs (a,b) and its midside m, add undirected (a,m) and (m,b); unique sorted pairs give 12 subedges per cell before deduplication.
fine_geometry_contract.W0: Symmetric binary adjacency: W0[i,j]=1 for every unique original subedge, 0 otherwise, diagonal0. The existing distance producer returns lengths, which must not be reused as these weights.
fine_geometry_contract.physical_edge_attributes: Store original endpoint displacement/L and positive edge length/L separately from W0; W0 is topology, not stiffness, conductance, or inverse physical length.
fine_geometry_contract.volume_mass_proxy: Let V_t be the existing positive physical corner-P1 tetra volume in mm3. m0[i]=sum over incident cells t of V_t/10 for each of all ten source nodes. This conserves sum_t V_t and gives positive nodal aggregation weights; it is not the quadratic consistent/lumped FE mass or exact curved-TETRA10 volume.
fine_geometry_contract.component_policy: Report full graph components, zero-degree nodes and each role-induced component count before aggregation. Never reconnect disconnected components geometrically. Genuine zero-degree rows use identity smoothing and singleton aggregation; unused/invalid geometry nodes or zero mass block preparation rather than inventing coordinates or mass.

hard_connected_hierarchy.notation: G0[N0,N1] and G1[N1,N2] are unsmoothed one-hot hard assignments. Each row has exactly one1. Graph levels are0 original,1 intermediate,2 coarse.
hard_connected_hierarchy.exact_role_signature: Validate original features[:,0:7] as binary input values and encode r_i=sum_b 2^b*flag_i,b. This preserves six SPC DOF bits and the actual loaded-member bit. Level1/2 inherit the same exact signature from their hard children; do not threshold averaged/smoothed roles.
hard_connected_hierarchy.role_component_lower_bound: For each level graph, form induced subgraphs for each exact role signature. Every connected component of every induced graph needs at least one aggregate; the sum is a mandatory lower bound and can exceed either soft target or hard limit even if the full graph has one component.
deterministic_bounded_BFS: At level l set growth_size=max(1,ceil(N_l/soft_target_l)); the target is a size heuristic, not an exact group count.
Use sorted CSR neighbors and process the smallest original-descendant node ID among unassigned vertices as the next seed, with exact-role signature recorded. No RNG or geometric anchor is used.

Grow a FIFO BFS only through unassigned actual-edge neighbors of that seed's exact role. Assign each discovered vertex immediately to the current aggregate and enqueue it, so every admitted vertex has a parent already in that aggregate.

Stop when growth_size vertices are admitted or the admissible frontier is empty; selected but unprocessed frontier vertices remain assigned. Repeat from the next smallest unassigned original-descendant ID until every vertex is assigned once.

Renumber aggregates by their minimum original-descendant node ID. Validate each aggregate's induced graph connectivity, exact role homogeneity, disjointness and complete coverage. No automatic role relaxation, anchor-nearest assignment, small-group merge, or target-forcing repair is part of this draft.

If actual N1>4096 or N2>512, or the role-component lower bound already exceeds the relevant hard limit, record blocked with counts and stop. Do not cross roles/components, add shortcuts or silently enlarge the budget. Root must select any later change.

coarse_graphs.W1: G0^T W0 G0 with diagonal removed; off-diagonal entry counts actual fine cut-edge connections between connected aggregates.
coarse_graphs.W2: G1^T W1 G1 with diagonal removed; retain positive cut-edge multiplicities rather than binarizing or replacing edges by centroid neighbors.
coarse_graphs.properties: Symmetric nonnegative adjacency with positive stored off-diagonal entries. Every quotient edge has at least one original mesh-path witness; every hard aggregate has a connected original descendant set.
coarse_graphs.coarse_positions_and_mass: Hard aggregation only: m1=G0^T m0, x1=diag(m1)^-1 G0^T diag(m0)x0; m2=G1^T m1, x2 analogously. Source-descendant minimum IDs/signatures and seven raw-role member counts/presence are retained. Named five-interface counts/provenance remain separate existing metadata, not inferred from seven bits.

smooth_prolongation.level_formula: For l=0,1 define D_l=diag(W_l*1), Lgraph_l=D_l-W_l, J_l=I-(2/3)D_l^-1 Lgraph_l=(1/3)I+(2/3)D_l^-1W_l on positive-degree rows. For a zero-degree row set J_l[i,i]=1 exactly and report it.
smooth_prolongation.proof: W_l is nonnegative and D_l its row sum, so J_l>=0 and J_l*1=1. G_l*1=1, hence P_l>=0 and P_l*1=1 after two passes. Constant coarse latents reproduce exactly in real arithmetic. These are positive row-stochastic maps; structurally absent entries remain0.
smooth_prolongation.R01_and_R12: For declared node-volume pooling, R_l=diag(P_l^T*m_l)^-1 P_l^T diag(m_l), with positive denominator guarded. Shapes R01[N1,N0],R12[N2,N1]; R_l*1=1. Save these sparse restrictions and denominator vectors. This smoothed restriction's effective pooled mass differs from hard m_{l+1}; distinguish them explicitly and do not substitute it for hard graph contraction.
smooth_prolongation.sparse_policy: Build in float64 CSR, coalesce duplicate paths, sort columns. No top-k, radius cutoff, threshold pruning, approximate nearest aggregate, or dropping small positive entries. Algebraically exact0 entries may be removed. Save complete support and both build/storage row-sum errors.
smooth_prolongation.storage: CSR data may be float32 after measured validation; row-sum error <=1e-6, no negative data, all finite. Fail rather than silently clip, renormalize, truncate or use float16 interpolation weights.
smooth_prolongation.local_support: P01 rows depend on aggregate labels reachable within two fine graph hops; P12 rows on labels reachable within two intermediate graph hops. P01*P12 may be applied associatively without materializing a dense/full composite. Two smoothing passes are not global elastic communication.
smooth_prolongation.role_mixing: J smoothing deliberately crosses ordinary actual edges, including different roles; P rows can mix coarse BC and free-space tokens. Hard G remains homogeneous. Original query BC43 remains available; this is neither hard BC enforcement nor a constraint interpolation matrix.
smooth_prolongation.continuity_limit: P removes the abrupt one-hot nearest-aggregate context assignment, but it is a discrete nodal smoother, not a C1 physical field, exact SDF or an affine/rigid-mode-preserving elastic prolongation. It does not guarantee lower physical P1 error; a nonlinear encoder/decoder can still create local variation.

BC_small_set_retention.source_groups: Existing graph-manifest metadata may record four actual support group counts in master-ID order and the actual loaded-group count/card type/mapping provenance; no new named-membership reconstruction is required for this input-only feasibility.
BC_small_set_retention.hard_roles: BC bits protect support/load versus free-space and different DOF signatures from hard merging. They do not uniquely name four support patches that happen to have identical bits.
BC_small_set_retention.per_level_records: For each of seven raw bits keep exact hard descendant member counts and presence, plus exact-signature counts. A nonempty bit must remain represented by a coarse token; never majority-threshold away a small role set. Named per-patch coarse membership is not claimed unless a separately allowed later input provides it.
BC_small_set_retention.overlap: Retain original overlapping raw bits; do not force disjoint roles or copy a guessed role onto nearby free nodes. Existing named-source metadata and seven raw bits remain immutable.
BC_small_set_retention.tradeoff_to_expose: Role-induced fragmentation can exceed soft targets or hard caps. Same-bit connected support patches may share an aggregate; smoothing mixes roles. Counts/presence preserve nonempty seven-bit sets but do not preserve named four-patch identity, exact patch geometry, DOF topology or load work transfer. Report these facts rather than claim exact BC preservation.

proposed_cache_interface.format: One immutable per-CAD input-only NPZ plus small JSON manifest; CSR arrays, never dense N0x2048.
proposed_cache_interface.sparse_arrays: For W0,W1,W2,P01,P12,R01,R12 store *_indptr[int64], *_indices[int64], *_data plus explicit shape; W0 values1, W1/W2 positive cut counts, P/R weights complete float32 validated from float64. Physical fine subedge lengths/vectors use a separately named array, not W-data.
manifest_required_facts: per-role component lower bounds and actual aggregate sizes
P/R nonzeros and min/max row support/row sum errors
bytes/peak-memory estimate and measured stage times
blocked reasons and source geometry hashes/stat identities
proposed_cache_interface.consumer_node_gather: Gather P01 rows by canonical original node indices supplied by the sampler; duplicated queries may gather the same row. Apply live coarse latents through sparse matrix products/gathers with gradients to learned tokens. No nearest-vertex substitution or target-dependent latent cache.
proposed_cache_interface.two_level_consumer: P12 maps N2-token latents to N1; P01 maps N1-token latents to original nodes. A later encoder must declare how level1 and level2 learned latents combine; this input-feasibility draft does not silently select a learned architecture.
proposed_cache_interface.future_continuous_query: Currently defined only at original nodes. Off-node use requires a separately declared original-element locator and shared TETRA10 ten-node shape-function interpolation to agree with saved midside nodal values; corner-only P1 interpolation or nearest-node copying changes the query semantics. No arbitrary-point guarantee is made here.

future_input_feasibility_acceptance: Only the four fixed TRAIN geometries; record0 label/model/GPU accesses and no fitted normalizer.
Original node/coordinate normalization/flags/source interface mapping replay; valid TETRA10 order and positive physical geometry/volume proxy.
Every node assigned exactly once; every hard aggregate connected and exact-role homogeneous; original components retained; actual sizes within4096/512 hard safety.
W symmetric, zero diagonal, positive stored actual-edge cut weights; positive masses and seven-bit representation at both levels; report every isolated identity row.
Both P/R maps nonnegative/finite/row-stochastic within storage tolerance, full support retained, constant test passes; no top-k or threshold pruning.
Synthetic sharp one-hot/constant examples demonstrate what two passes do and do not preserve; no affine/rigid or target-gradient accuracy claim from constant reproduction.

Report per-CAD runtime/memory/nonzeros/role fragmentation and sparse query reach before any model or45-CAD expansion is selected. Any failure is blocked with evidence, without automated algorithm/budget changes.

complexity_and_unknowns.construction: Unique original edges require sorting/deduplication of12T emitted subedges; sorted-CSR BFS and hard contraction are O(N+E) after deduplication, with no O(N*2048) anchor-distance computation. Role/component verification is O(N+E). Two sparse prolongation products cost proportional to actual neighbor support unions and can expand nonzeros; no uniform small-k bound is promised.
complexity_and_unknowns.memory: O(N+E+nnz(P01)+nnz(P12)) plus source cell connectivity; no dense N0xN1 tensor. Known metadata puts these four original graphs at179316–270276 vertices and611812–923364 directed CSR entries per CAD. Exact intermediate nonzeros/peak memory remain unmeasured.
complexity_and_unknowns.future_training: Static maps can be cached, learned graph states cannot. Only later root-selected code may recompute sampled-CAD tokens per step and feed32 context slots. Coarse encoder edge activations, backward cost, native input-gradient routing and runtime versus old query pooling need separate measured acceptance.
unmeasured: role-induced component counts and whether4096/512 are feasible
actual N1/N2, thin-bridge aggregation quality and quotient graph reach
whether eventual learned context improves joint u/P1 or CAD transfer
complexity_and_unknowns.stopping: A future implementation must publish its fixed resource safety limits before reading/processing arrays; stop with a blocked artifact instead of silently pruning P or changing targets. This draft authorizes no execution.

sources_and_limits.evidence: EDGE_ORDER and build_graph implement the actual unique12 corner-mid subedges and physical length/L; this draft explicitly separates those distance weights from binary W.

Bi-Stride Multi-Scale GNN motivates topology-aware BFS hierarchy and warns that spatial proximity can introduce wrong mesh edges. Its simulation results do not establish DeepJEB static-elastic utility.

Official jacobi_prolongation_smoother applies repeated Jacobi updates to a tentative prolongator. Its general AMG implementation estimates a spectral radius and may filter entries; this draft instead explicitly derives fixed graph-Laplacian J, no spectral estimate/filter, and proves constant/nonnegative preservation.
Nonnegative row-stochastic J and one-hot G imply P=J²G is nonnegative and constant preserving. This says nothing about stiffness, long-range elasticity, remeshing invariance or exact physical strain.

decision_boundary: Root adoption/freezing is required before even the input-only4-CAD preparation. This is not a selected GPU experiment, new physics law or novel smoothing algorithm. Current target u/P1, calibrated loss/scaler, load linearity and closed validation/dia/final-test policies remain unchanged.
